user.title: Connect to Yubii
user.description: Sign in with your Yubii ID. Credentials are stored in Home Assistant configuration to allow reconnection.

devices.title: Select devices
devices.description: Select main devices. All supported sensors and controls are included automatically, with one battery sensor per device. Control thermostats, switches, lights and covers from Home Assistant. Names come from Fibaro. New entities on selected devices are added automatically. Deselecting a device removes its entities from Home Assistant.

error.invalid_auth: Cloud or hub authentication failed. Check the credentials.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect or received an unexpected response.
